# Farm reference

_Generated from `scripts/home/home_layout.gd`, `scripts/core/work.gd`, `scripts/home/home_gather.gd`, `scripts/core/data.gd`, `content/kin`._

Everything you can place in build mode (B), from `HomeLayout.CATALOG`. Costs are gems plus building materials.

## Buildings

| Item | Cost | Tiles | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| House | 90 gems | 5x3 | Your home. Go inside to rest and decorate; Boki nap here too. Its door needs open ground. (one only) |
| Crop patch | 30 gems | 5x4 | Four plots of tilled soil to sow and water. Buying more plots at the market makes room for another patch. Put it within 2 tiles of water and it waters itself. |
| Cooking pot | 20 gems | 1x1 | Cook what you grow into treats for your Boki. (one only) |
| Market stall | 30 gems | 3x2 | Somewhere to trade on the island (the Market is always on the hub bar too). (one only) |
| Nesting Nook | 60 gems, 8 wood | 4x2 | Where two close Boki leave an egg, with the Incubator beside it for Rare Eggs. (one only) |
| Boki Burrow | 40 gems, 6 wood, 4 stone | 3x2 | Where Boki who aren't out on the farm curl up and sleep. (one only) |
| Training post | 35 gems, 6 wood | 2x2 | Train a Boki's moves against the dummy. (one only) |
| Graveyard | 25 gems, 6 stone | 4x6 | A quiet corner for Boki who died. Their graves wait here (and the Soul Shrine can bring one back). (one only) |

## Work

| Item | Cost | Tiles | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Job Board | 30 gems | 1x1 | Set which jobs matter (Off to High) and see who's doing what. Pin a Boki to a job, or let it rest. |
| Lumber Camp | 40 gems | 2x1 | **Timber Boki.** Timber Boki fell the wild trees within 5 tiles, then split its log pile (it grows back). |
| Quarry | 40 gems | 2x1 | **Stone Boki.** Stone Boki break the wild boulders within 5 tiles, then mine its rock (it grows back). |
| Storage Chest | 25 gems | 1x1 | **Haul Boki.** Haul Boki bring it the wood and stone that's lying about, and take food from it to feeders that run low. |
| Hearth Oven | 60 gems, 6 wood, 4 stone | 1x1 | **Ember Boki.** Ember Boki bake a firewood log into 2 Boki kibble (3 for a skilled baker). |
| Workbench | 50 gems, 8 wood | 2x1 | **Craft Boki.** Craft Boki turn 2 wood and a stone into scrap for upgrades and statues. |
| Spark Mill | 80 gems, 8 wood, 6 stone, 2 scrap | 1x1 | **Spark Boki.** Spark Boki crank it up. While it has charge, the oven, workbench and infirmary work 50% faster. |
| Cold Store | 70 gems, 4 wood, 8 stone | 1x1 | **Frost Boki.** Frost Boki keep it cold. While it's chilled, food stays fresh and every meal fills 15% more. |
| Ranch Pen | 60 gems, 10 wood | 3x2 | **Ranch Boki.** Up to two Ranch Boki lounge here and make things over time (glowcaps, sweet buns, kibble). |
| Infirmary | 70 gems, 6 wood, 6 stone | 2x1 | **Mend Boki.** Mend Boki look after tired, glum or hungry Boki, and brew tonics here when nobody needs them. |
| Seed Garden | 35 gems, 4 wood | 2x2 | **Bloom Boki.** A Bloom Boki you assign raises seedlings here: a common seed every few minutes, even while you're away. |
| Kiln | 45 gems, 8 stone | 1x1 | **Ember Boki.** An Ember Boki you assign burns 3 wood into an Ember Coal for the Incubator, even while you're away. |

## Work elements

Each Boki has a few farm knacks (level 1 to 4). The best-suited Boki takes each job on its own.

| Element | Job | What it does | Boki with it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tide | Watering | Waters the crops so they grow. | Kestrike 2, Mirrolin 3, Boltstrich 2, Bubblisk 3, Prismander 3, Barokat 2, Barrelmander 2, Canvastross 2, Zephyrak 2 |
| Bloom | Planting | Sows seeds in empty plots and tends growing crops along. | Mycroll 3, Glomwort 3, Crofthorn 3, Soakybara 3, Marchleaf 2, Mossgrade 3, Spirevark 2, Murmurling 2, Terrasloth 3, Prismander 1, Knotwyrm 3, Hivara 3 |
| Forage | Harvesting | Picks ripe crops into your pantry. | Mycroll 2, Zippelith 3, Vespyx 1, Bellowary 1, Snuffapi 3, Ermink 2, Gongibbon 2, Gloamshell 3, Crofthorn 2, Anvilbrock 1, Kindlewren 1, Soakybara 2, Mossgrade 2, Nettlynx 1, Terrasloth 2, Chuggamus 1, Thrumbird 2, Umbrathere 3, Pipewurm 1, Echolop 1 |
| Ember | Kindling | Keeps the Hearth Oven going (firewood becomes Boki kibble), and warms the Incubator's Rare Egg twice as fast. | Vespyx 3, Bellowary 3, Anvilbrock 3, Kindlewren 3, Nettlynx 3, Chuggamus 3, Pipewurm 3 |
| Timber | Lumbering | Fells the wild trees round a Lumber Camp and splits its logs into wood. | Rampartoad 2, Anchorbill 1, Glintmole 2, Effigeetle 2, Buckleron 2, Lodestick 1, Gravadillo 2, Lockatara 1, Cairnback 3 |
| Stone | Mining | Breaks the boulders round a Quarry and mines its rock into stone. | Rampartoad 3, Anchorbill 3, Glintmole 3, Effigeetle 3, Buckleron 3, Lodestick 3, Gravadillo 3, Lockatara 2, Cairnback 4 |
| Craft | Crafting | Turns wood and stone into scrap at the Workbench. | Zippelith 2, Bellowary 2, Snuffapi 2, Ermink 3, Frigatee 2, Gongibbon 1, Prowyak 2, Gloamshell 2, Skateron 2, Anvilbrock 2, Kindlewren 2, Marchleaf 1, Lanterloris 1, Spirevark 1, Murmurling 1, Mirrolin 2, Bubblisk 2, Rimeshrew 2, Chuggamus 2, Selenfin 1, Thrumbird 1, Umbrathere 2, Lunowl 2, Hivara 2 |
| Spark | Powering | Cranks the Spark Mill: a powered farm works half again as fast. | Gongibbon 3, Kestrike 3, Boltstrich 3, Barokat 3, Barrelmander 3, Canvastross 3, Thrumbird 3, Echolop 3, Zephyrak 4 |
| Frost | Cooling | Keeps the Cold Store cold: fresh food fills Boki up 15% more. | Frigatee 3, Prowyak 3, Skateron 3, Lanterloris 3, Rimeshrew 3, Selenfin 3, Lunowl 2 |
| Haul | Hauling | Carries logs and stone to the Storage Chest, and food to feeders that run low. | Rampartoad 1, Zippelith 1, Anchorbill 2, Snuffapi 1, Glintmole 1, Gloamshell 1, Effigeetle 1, Kestrike 1, Buckleron 1, Lodestick 2, Boltstrich 1, Gravadillo 2, Barokat 1, Barrelmander 1, Canvastross 1, Lockatara 3, Umbrathere 1, Echolop 2, Cairnback 2, Zephyrak 2 |
| Mend | Mending | Cheers up tired, glum or hungry Boki, and brews tonics at the Infirmary. | Vespyx 1, Ermink 1, Frigatee 1, Prowyak 1, Glomwort 2, Crofthorn 1, Skateron 1, Soakybara 1, Lanterloris 2, Mossgrade 1, Mirrolin 1, Nettlynx 2, Bubblisk 1, Terrasloth 1, Prismander 2, Rimeshrew 1, Selenfin 2, Knotwyrm 2, Pipewurm 2 |
| Ranch | Ranching | Lounges in the Ranch Pen and makes things: glowcaps, sweet buns, kibble. | Mycroll 1, Glomwort 1, Marchleaf 3, Spirevark 3, Murmurling 3, Knotwyrm 1, Lunowl 1, Hivara 4 |

## Crops

A watered plant grows a stage every 90 seconds at home, and every expedition grows everything a stage.

| Crop | Stages | Seed price (gems) | What it's for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Emberberry | 2 | 20 | Treat: your Boki deals 25% more damage next match. |
| Tidebloom | 1 | 12 | Brews 2 tonics. Key 1 in a match heals 45. |
| Sunroot | 2 | 18 | Treat: your Boki has 40% more health next match. |
| Mindmint | 3 | 25 | Treat: +12 trust. Calm Boki follow risky orders. |
| Puffcorn | 1 | 8 | Snack: your partner gets +4 trust right away. Quick and cheap. |
| Glowcap | 2 | 30 | Treat: your partner learns half again as much next match. |
| Starfruit | 4 | 60 | Rare. Your partner gains a level right away (once a day). |
